summary: Partition the composer footer-width Storybook gallery into smaller stories while preserving its policy and width coverage

replay.detail: Only Storybook fixtures and CI case inventories change; no runtime replay changes.

schema.detail: No database schema, migration, index, or trigger changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or coordinated member upgrade changes.

compatibility.detail: No application client, protocol, pairing, or provider admission changes. Internal Storybook gallery IDs become width-specific and all CI policy references migrate together.

downtime.detail: No deployed service changes or additional interruption.

manual.detail: Existing installations require no action; the change only reduces per-story jsdom fixture work.

recovery.detail: No runtime recovery or swap-back changes; persistent installation state is untouched.
